smoothness.qualification: Frozen before training. 249.81 s is the first successful engineering reference; the 275 s pilot threshold allows 10% overhead. Report all walking, task and recovery measurements separately; contact travel is a sampled proxy. Lateral peak-to-peak limit is 60 mm, frozen against the 53.56 mm engineering reference before model training.

objective.selection: Qualified completion and safety first, then meeting both development cost targets without longer time, then lowest normalized steps plus recovery arm travel plus0.1time. Prefer earlier update on ties.
objective.time_scope: New420-second feasibility horizon declared for new book-turn and paper route before training; all weights and baselines use it.

selection_without_qualified_parent.rule: Maximize qualified completion, then fewer falls/contacts, then minimize steps/500 + mean recovery joint travel/5 + 0.1*time/420. Earlier checkpoint breaks exact ties. No primary paired efficiency claim without a qualified parent.
